# chatnet from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/chatnet.c, with the line framing from
# src/main/protutil.c (both compiled unmodified). This is the plain-text chat
# protocol third-party bots speak.
#
# NO SOCKET IS OPENED to produce this file. do_sp_read and do_sp_write are the
# only routines in either module that touch one, and neither is called: the
# driver fills and drains the connection buffers itself, which is all those two
# do either side of the recv and send.
#
# WHAT IS NOT HERE. chatnet.c owns framing, dispatch and outbound formatting. It
# does NOT own the protocol's commands -- LOGIN is registered by core.c, GO and
# LEAVE by arenaman.c, SEND by chat.c and CHANGEFREQ by game.c -- so what a
# handler DOES with its arguments is out of scope for this file. What is pinned
# here is everything that happens to a bot's bytes before a handler sees them,
# and everything that happens to a line on its way back out.
#
#   seat <chars>   one per player: 'c' a chat client, 'v' a VIE game client,
#      'o' a chat client in another arena, 'n' one not yet playing
#   handler <command> <tag>   registered a recording handler for that command
#   feed <player> <offered> <taken> <hex>   appended bytes to that client's
#      inbound buffer, as a read from the socket would. <taken> is what FITTED
#      and the hex is those bytes; the two differ only for the over-long records.
#   inbuf <player> <n> <hex>   what is left in that buffer afterwards. '- -'
#      means there is no buffer at all, which is not the same as an empty one.
#   process <player>   called do_sp_process once
#   call <tag> <player> [<rest>]   a handler that fired; <null> means the module
#      passed a null rest rather than an empty string
#   sendone <player> [<line>] / sendarena except=<n> [<line>]   sent a line
#   to <player>        whose outbox the following 'out' lines belong to
#   out <n> <hex>      a line queued for a client, as bytes
#
# Rules these records pin:
#
# 1. do_sp_process HANDLES ONE LINE PER CALL, not all the lines in the buffer.
#    A bot that sends two commands in one TCP segment has the second one held
#    until the next iteration of the server's loop. The leftover is copied into
#    a fresh buffer and the old one freed, so the buffer is not compacted in
#    place -- which matters only if a port tries to keep a read offset.
# 2. A LINE ENDS AT CR *OR* LF, and every run of them after it is consumed. So
#    CRLF, LFCR, bare CR and bare LF all work, and a blank line between two
#    commands is swallowed rather than dispatched as an empty command.
# 3. THE COMMAND IS SPLIT FROM THE REST AT THE FIRST COLON ONLY. Everything
#    after it, colons included, is the rest. A line with NO colon dispatches
#    with a NULL rest, which process_line then turns into the empty string --
#    so a handler never sees null, but the two cases are distinguishable right
#    up to that point, and the records below show both.
# 4. AN OVER-LONG LINE IS DISCARDED, NOT TRUNCATED, and only once the buffer is
#    completely full: the test is LEFT(buf) <= 0 with no terminator anywhere, and
#    then the WHOLE buffer is thrown away. The records below show both halves of
#    what that means. A complete line sitting in FRONT of the over-long run is
#    dispatched normally first, because the terminator search looks anywhere in
#    the buffer, not just at the front. But anything that arrives BEHIND the run
#    goes when the discard comes -- the 'GO:after' line below is swallowed with
#    the 2023 bytes of padding it was queued behind. There is no
#    resynchronisation: a bot cannot recover by sending a newline, because the
#    buffer is already full and the next byte it sends is dropped on the floor by
#    the feed itself.
# 5. DISPATCH IS BY EXACT, CASE-INSENSITIVE COMMAND MATCH into a hash table, and
#    EVERY handler registered for that command fires, in registration order.
#    An unknown command is silently dropped -- no error goes back to the bot.
# 6. OUTBOUND LINES ARE LF-TERMINATED, not CRLF, and the terminator is added by
#    get_out_buffer after formatting.
# 7. OUTBOUND LINES ARE TRUNCATED AT 2033 BYTES. real_send formats with
#    vsnprintf(buf, MAXMSGSIZE - 2, ...), whose size argument INCLUDES the NUL,
#    so at most 2032 characters survive, and the LF then makes 2033 on the wire.
#    A bot cannot be sent a longer line however long the message is.
# 8. SendToOne CHECKS ONLY THAT THE PLAYER IS A CHAT CLIENT -- not their status,
#    not their arena. SendToArena additionally requires S_PLAYING, the right
#    arena, and not being the excepted player. So a chat client that has not
#    finished entering can still be sent a direct line but will not see arena
#    traffic. A VIE game client is skipped by both.
sizes MAXMSGSIZE=2035 sp_conn=44
seat cccv
handler SEND A
handler GO B
# one complete line
feed 0 15 15 53454e443a5055423a68656c6c6f0a
inbuf 0 15 53454e443a5055423a68656c6c6f0a
process 0
call A 0 [PUB:hello]
inbuf 0 - -
# two complete lines in one read: the second waits for the next call
feed 0 26 26 474f3a6172656e61310a53454e443a5055423a7365636f6e640a
inbuf 0 26 474f3a6172656e61310a53454e443a5055423a7365636f6e640a
process 0
call B 0 [arena1]
inbuf 0 16 53454e443a5055423a7365636f6e640a
process 0
call A 0 [PUB:second]
inbuf 0 - -
process 0
inbuf 0 - -
# a partial line: nothing is dispatched until the terminator arrives
feed 0 12 12 53454e443a5055423a706172
inbuf 0 12 53454e443a5055423a706172
process 0
inbuf 0 12 53454e443a5055423a706172
feed 0 5 5 7469616c0a
inbuf 0 17 53454e443a5055423a7061727469616c0a
process 0
call A 0 [PUB:partial]
inbuf 0 - -
# every terminator form, and a blank line between commands
feed 0 17 17 474f3a610d0a474f3a620a0d474f3a630d
inbuf 0 17 474f3a610d0a474f3a620a0d474f3a630d
process 0
call B 0 [a]
inbuf 0 11 474f3a620a0d474f3a630d
process 0
call B 0 [b]
inbuf 0 5 474f3a630d
process 0
call B 0 [c]
inbuf 0 - -
process 0
inbuf 0 - -
# no colon at all: the rest is null, not empty
feed 0 3 3 474f0a
inbuf 0 3 474f0a
process 0
call B 0 []
inbuf 0 - -
# a trailing colon: the rest IS empty
feed 0 4 4 474f3a0a
inbuf 0 4 474f3a0a
process 0
call B 0 []
inbuf 0 - -
# only the first colon splits
feed 0 23 23 53454e443a505249563a626f623a68693a74686572650a
inbuf 0 23 53454e443a505249563a626f623a68693a74686572650a
process 0
call A 0 [PRIV:bob:hi:there]
inbuf 0 - -
# an unknown command is silently dropped
feed 0 16 16 4e4f53554348434f4d4d414e443a780a
inbuf 0 16 4e4f53554348434f4d4d414e443a780a
process 0
inbuf 0 - -
# command matching is case-insensitive
feed 0 15 15 73656e643a5055423a6c6f7765720a
inbuf 0 15 73656e643a5055423a6c6f7765720a
process 0
call A 0 [PUB:lower]
inbuf 0 - -
# two handlers on one command both fire, in registration order
handler GO C
feed 0 8 8 474f3a626f74680a
inbuf 0 8 474f3a626f74680a
process 0
call B 0 [both]
call C 0 [both]
inbuf 0 - -
# a complete line queued behind an over-long one is lost with it
feed 1 11 11 474f3a77616974696e670a
inbuf 1 11 474f3a77616974696e670a
feed 1 4096 2023 
inbuf 1 2034 
process 1
call B 1 [waiting]
call C 1 [waiting]
inbuf 1 2023 
# the buffer was full with no terminator, so all of it went
feed 1 9 9 474f3a61667465720a
inbuf 1 2032 
process 1
inbuf 1 - -
# outbound lines are LF-terminated
sendone 0 [MSG:ARENA:hello there]
out 22 4d53473a4152454e413a68656c6c6f2074686572650a
sendone 0 [NOOP]
out 5 4e4f4f500a
# SendToOne ignores status and arena, but not client type
seat cnov
sendone 1 [MSG:PRIV:to a player still entering]
out 36 4d53473a505249563a746f206120706c61796572207374696c6c20656e746572696e670a
sendone 2 [MSG:PRIV:to a player in another arena]
out 38 4d53473a505249563a746f206120706c6179657220696e20616e6f74686572206172656e610a
sendone 3 [MSG:PRIV:to a VIE client]
# SendToArena filters on status, arena, except and client type
seat ccnov
sendarena except=-1 [MSG:ARENA:everyone]
to 0
out 19 4d53473a4152454e413a65766572796f6e650a
to 1
out 19 4d53473a4152454e413a65766572796f6e650a
sendarena except=0 [MSG:ARENA:everyone but p0]
to 1
out 26 4d53473a4152454e413a65766572796f6e65206275742070300a
seat c
# a 4000-character line comes out at the cap
sendone 0 []
out 2033
